text:
Situation: Ibutilide fumarate has been on FDA's shortage list since 2022-04-29 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 54 months. Corvale General holds 54 vials (0.1 mg/mL, 10 mL) with 4.5 vials used per day, providing 11.9 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 12 vials at 1 vial per day, providing 12.3 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): The product label identifies Pharmacia & Upjohn Company LLC (FEI 1810189) as the registered plant for manufacture, analysis, API manufacture, labeling, and packing. FDA inspection 1208260 at that plant ended 2023-06-16 and was classified VAI, with the classification letter dated 2024-09-10 — 413 days after the shortage posting on 2022-04-29. Earlier FDA inspections at the same plant (564470, 682230, 746375, 796422, 837169, 933762, 1066512) were also classified VAI between 2009 and 2018.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately 12 days at both sites. The rule-based best option is to purchase from Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today, though its label names no plant we could place.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to initiate purchase from Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc. — requires P&T committee approval.
2. Buyer to verify supply continuity and labeling details with the supplier — requires P&T committee approval.
3. Buyer to monitor FDA shortage list for status changes — requires P&T committee approval.

Not recommended: No alternative sourcing or clinical changes at this time.
